integrity: Proof and standalone exhaustive finite checker are included; self-review only, no independent audit and no claim that searches establish uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple cactus graphs only; triangular cycle uniquely non-real; K1/K2 have separate formulas; no all-graph root theorem, no independent validation, incomplete full-text access for one recent root paper.
title: Connected-domination polynomials of cacti: block factors and a unique root exception
